summary: 17 MAI KOMITEEN RISKA (org. no. 916 327 900) is an association (FLI) based in Sandnes, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2015-12-03. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 79.121 (Aktiviteter utført av utflukts- og eventarrangører); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Kristine Østebø Sivertsen.
